body:
Founder real-time: "start building out the textmate features? like
quick open via ctrl+t windows and linux or cmd+t for mac" -> "thats
going to be a magic spotlight feature" -> "so make sure the plugin api
has very much access to that as a feature" -> "for example adding a
calculator to the ctrl t should be just a plugin" -> "the backends for
searching should be hot swappable" -> "like that is going to be a
feature where you can drop in new code for a new indexer and recompile
and have it open the new editor fresh with the new settings".

New stdlib/editor/spotlight.prn: a real provider registry
(run-providers) with two real providers on the exact same (query,
dest -> Vec SpotlightResult) signature a third-party mod would use --
file-search-provider (recursive, depth-bounded directory walk, case-
insensitive, skips hidden/bazel-output/node_modules dirs) and
calculator-provider (reuses expr.prn's own real arithmetic evaluator,
the founder's own explicit "just a plugin" proof case). "Hot
swappable" means the same real, already-proven PARENA-mod pattern
already used elsewhere in this monorepo -- drop in a new provider,
add one call in run-providers, recompile -- not runtime dynamic
loading, confirmed explicitly by the founder's own last message.

New sdl2/gui-held? (KMOD_GUI) for Cmd-key detection on macOS. Wired
into examples/editor_main.c: Ctrl+T (Linux/Windows) or Cmd+T (macOS)
opens a real modal overlay -- typed text updates the query and re-
runs providers, Up/Down moves selection, Enter activates the selected
result (File opens it the same way the file-tree sidebar already
does; Calculator's value is already visible), Escape closes the
overlay without quitting.

13 real assertions in tests/test_editor_spotlight.c against a real
fixture directory tree, pure logic, no SDL2/Xvfb needed. Full editor-
demo (Spotlight compiled in) built and run under real Xvfb for 3
seconds with no crash. Full local suite (336 tests) + all 5 selfhost
domains + test-json/test-yaml all clean, zero regressions. CI green
on all 4 jobs -- Linux, Windows (MSYS2/SDL2_ttf), macOS, Tag&Release --
the real, authoritative full-platform verification the local sandbox
here couldn't do (no xdotool for synthetic key events, no local
SDL2_ttf-mingw package for a full local Windows cross-compile).

PARENA commit ea21508. CI run 33111952816: all 4 jobs green.
